landing_event_structure.LANDING_FIRST_CONTACT: first sample after physical takeoff with any foot-floor contact row AND foot_clearance <= 0 for that foot
landing_event_structure.BILATERAL_LANDING_ESTABLISHED: first time after LANDING_FIRST_CONTACT where both feet have plantar contact rows AND both feet carry Fz > F_thr, sustained D_BL
landing_event_structure.LANDING_ASYMMETRY: abs(t_first_contact_left - t_first_contact_right) plus force-share asymmetry over the establishment window
landing_event_structure.asymmetry_policy: slight asynchrony allowed within declared bounds; microsecond equality neither required nor claimed; no evidence supports exact simultaneity

L4_landing_validity.principle: whole-body post-impact admissible state; abs(com_vz) < V_ABS_TAIL alone is insufficient

hard_gates.DEFINITION: prior certified physical flight (E7) and descending COM at first contact
hard_gates.INVALID_OUTCOME_PREVENTED: landing scored without a preceding genuine flight

hard_gates.DEFINITION: no fall contact and no prohibited contact in [E9, E10_confirmation]
hard_gates.INVALID_OUTCOME_PREVENTED: landing on a fall shell or support substitute

hard_gates.DEFINITION: bilateral landing established: t_bilateral_load - t_LANDING_FIRST_CONTACT <= D_EST (OD-10 candidate 0.050 s), then both feet loaded sustained for D_BL
maximum floor penetration in landing window
hard_gates.INVALID_OUTCOME_PREVENTED: contact solver pushed beyond its admissible regime

hard_gates.DEFINITION: no post-landing reflight beyond approved chatter (chatter transitions <= 8)
hard_gates.INVALID_OUTCOME_PREVENTED: lost landing hidden by a later nominal frame

hard_gates.DEFINITION: peak landing whole-body vertical force normalized to body weight
hard_gates.INVALID_OUTCOME_PREVENTED: impact beyond the declared landing-force envelope

task_gates.DEFINITION: sagittal COM horizontal velocity at E10 confirmation

RETIRED_REDUNDANT: the E10 predicate already requires abs(com_vz) < V_ABS_TAIL continuously through confirmation; retained only as the transient window operand MAX_ABS_COM_VZ_LANDING_WINDOW (diagnostic)

task_gates.NOTE: trunk flexion at landing is mechanically permissible (Blackburn 2008/2009); the defect is the un-captured forward lunge

task_gates.DEFINITION: behavioral window [E10_confirmation, E11_onset]: max(abs(com_vx)) <= max(abs(COM_VX_AT_E10), VX_TAIL_CAP) AND COM_X_MAX_AFTER_LANDING := max over [LANDING_FIRST_CONTACT, E11_onset] of (com_x(t) - com_x(LANDING_FIRST_CONTACT)) <= X_FWD_MAX; if E11 never onsets the gate is NOT_EVALUABLE and LANDING_VALID=false
task_gates.NOTE: prevents the R001 forward lunge (com_vx 0.211 -> 0.342 m/s after touchdown) directly; the window is explicit and is evaluated by the L4 layer
bounds horizontal momentum during the impact-absorption interval (ADV-7 closure)

task_gates.DEFINITION: over [LANDING_FIRST_CONTACT, E10_confirmation]: max abs(root_pitch_rate) <= RATE_LAND_W, max abs(trunk_pitch_rate) <= RATE_LAND_W, max abs(Hy) <= HY_LAND_W, and mid-window posture envelope max root_pitch <= PITCH_LAND_W, max trunk_pitch <= TRUNK_LAND_W; prevent a transient landing whip that decays before the E10 point-in-time sample
task_gates.NOTE: ADV-4 closure; bound (not a proof); NC-05 includes a decaying-whip fixture; HY_LAND_W aligned with HY_AT_E10 (no evidence for allowing a larger transient)
task_gates.EVIDENCE_BASIS: none from R001 landing-window rates (UNKNOWN_NOT_EVALUABLE); engineering bound pending OD-04

balance_capture_variables.DEFINITION: centroidal angular momentum about sagittal y
COM ground projection to active support hull boundary
posture and rates for recovery readiness

E11_bounds.PROVENANCE: structure informed by TTS/DPSI (Chen 2026; Ross 2005; Wikstrom 2007) and capture-point reasoning (Hof 2005); clinical thresholds NOT imported
positive margin required; numeric tied to RES-84 support-hull measurement

structure_supported: capture is sustained over a window not an instant
AP and vertical dimensions both matter
dynamic_postural_stability_research_note.transfer_prohibition: clinical ACLI/ACLR and ankle-instability thresholds are not task-success thresholds for this simulation COU

RECOVERY_READY.DEFINITION: E11 predicate holds AND posture within RES-87 recovery-entry set AND posture rates within RES-87 bounds AND CoP inside recovery-entry hull fraction AND no penetration issue during [E9, s]
RECOVERY_READY.NON_RETROACTIVITY: an eventual E12 cannot validate a bad E10/E11 state; layers evaluated on their own windows

components.REQUIREMENT: inside standing posture set from multiple perturbed holds
com_speed_sagittal and joint rates below quiet-standing bounds
bilateral plantar support; Fz_whole in band around body weight
valid CoP inside standing hull fraction

E12_standing_envelope.calibration_requirement: RES-87 must derive the envelope from a family of perturbed initial standing states with a declared robustness target (remain in or return to the envelope)
prohibited_definitions: equality to one historical deterministic standing trace
micron-scale windows derived from a single hold
ULP-adjacent bound expansion presented as robustness
a dwell certified across controller regimes without separate reporting

recovery_maintenance.REQUIREMENT: over [E11_confirmation, E12_confirmation] the E11 capture bounds (com_speed_sagittal, abs(Hy), support_margin, cop_valid, bilateral support) continue to hold at every sample; a capture->excursion->re-stabilize sequence fails RECOVERY_VALID
recovery_maintenance.NOTE: closes the F6 scope gap; fall/reflight/prohibited remain whole-episode hard gates

hard_safety_vs_task_separation.RULE: no human-plausibility gate is presented as physical impossibility; no physical failure is hidden as style

layer_outputs.LANDING_VALID: boolean: point-in-time L4-T1..T7 at E10 confirmation AND hard gates L4-G1..G6 over their declared windows AND L4-T8 over [E10_confirmation, E11_onset] AND L4-T9/L4-T10 over [LANDING_FIRST_CONTACT, E10_confirmation]; if E11 does not onset, L4-T8 is NOT_EVALUABLE and LANDING_VALID=false
layer_outputs.RECOVERY_VALID: boolean over [E11_confirmation, E12_confirmation or horizon] AND continued E11 capture bounds over that interval AND FULL_EPISODE support continuity QUALIFIED AND POST_E12_OBSERVATION_MARGIN satisfied
layer_outputs.rule: TASK_SUCCESS requires all three; EVENT_CHAIN_VALID alone never implies them

r001_landing_evidence.verdict_under_candidates: FAIL L4-T3 and L4-T8; layer failed by independent causes
